english.note: This is the all-purpose noun phrase for how simple, uncomplicated, or straightforward something is.

examples.english: The simplicity of this tutorial is just right; you understand it after reading it once.
examples.traditional: 呢個教學嘅簡單程度啱啱好，睇一次就明。
